name: Carousel
description: Multi-photo post: a cover, 4–8 body slides with one point each and a CTA slide. Facebook shows it as a photo grid, not a swipe, so the cover must work alone and the first slides must make sense side by side

producer.note: agentic-image --from and asset.json arrive in its build step 5: until then start agentic-image new <slug> --format carousel and give it brief.md, or the human makes the slides by hand (e.g. Canva)
